description: This Java class provides generic JPA DAO support with methods for entity management, querying, and transaction handling, used within the sales manager application.

classes.name: SalesManagerJpaDaoSupport
classes.description: A support class for JPA data access objects, providing common CRUD and query operations.

methods.name: buildTypedQuery
methods.description: Creates a TypedQuery with optional limit and offset.

methods.name: filterCriteriaQuery
methods.description: Applies a filter expression to a CriteriaQuery.

methods.name: rootCriteriaQuery
methods.description: Creates a root for a CriteriaQuery.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves an entity by class and ID.

methods.name: getByField
methods.description: Retrieves an entity by a specific field value.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes an entity's state from the database.

methods.name: listEntity
methods.description: Lists entities with optional filtering, ordering, limit, and offset.

methods.name: listEntityByField
methods.description: Lists entities filtered by a specific field.

methods.name: countEntity
methods.description: Counts total entities of a class.

methods.name: countEntityByField
methods.description: Counts entities filtered by a specific field.

methods.name: getSingleResultOrNull
methods.description: Returns a single result or null if none found.
